(1) thematic investigations can provide students and teachers with a framework for studying the stories of people's lived experiences; and (2) thematic investigations provide students and teachers a systematic approach for studying the stories and experiences of people's lives.

thematic investigations provide a systematic framework for using multiple tools of inquiry to study the stories of people's lived experiences; and thematic investigations provide a link between social studies content and critical literacy.
thematic investigations are an effective tool for teaching social studies that promotes critical literacy and critical thinking.

the ways in which students and teachers engage with social studies as a critical literacy practice.
the development of critical social studies through thematic investigations.
